faq.title: Everything You Need to Know About Synthflow's AI Voice Agents

what.question: What is Synthflow?
what.answer: Synthflow is an enterprise-ready Voice AI platform that enables businesses to deploy AI-powered phone agents for automated customer conversations. Our platform handles everything from inbound support calls to outbound campaigns, with enterprise-grade reliability and compliance.

trial.question: Does Synthflow offer a free trial?
trial.answer: Yes, Synthflow offers a free trial so you can experience the platform's capabilities. Contact our sales team to get started with a personalized demo and trial access tailored to your use case.

support.question: We already have a support team. Why use Synthflow?
support.answer: Synthflow augments your existing team by handling routine calls, after-hours support, and overflow during peak times. This lets your human agents focus on complex, high-value interactions while AI handles repetitive tasks—improving efficiency and customer satisfaction.

security.question: Is Synthflow secure and compliant?
security.answer: Absolutely. Synthflow is certified across SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and GDPR. We provide full encryption, audit logs, region-based hosting, and enterprise-grade security built into every release.

customize.question: Can I customize Synthflow for my workflows?
customize.answer: Yes, Synthflow is highly customizable. You can design conversation flows with our visual builder, connect to your existing CRM and tools via 200+ integrations, and train agents on your specific knowledge base.

integrate.question: Can Synthflow integrate with our current tools?
integrate.answer: Synthflow integrates with 200+ platforms including Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshworks, and many more. We also support SIP trunking and BYOC for telephony flexibility.

brand.question: What if the AI says something off-brand?
brand.answer: Synthflow agents follow defined logic and approved knowledge sources, ensuring compliant, brand-safe replies. Our platform prevents off-script or hallucinated responses through strict guardrails and human escalation options.

stuck.question: What happens if the AI gets stuck?
stuck.answer: If an AI agent encounters a situation it can't handle, it seamlessly escalates to a human agent with full context. You can configure escalation rules based on sentiment, keywords, or specific scenarios.
